sampling.source_clock: actual presentation timestamps normalized to first frame
sampling.reset: New Vision/tracker state at source start for every phase/offset; never reset at sign core
sampling.source_geometry: aspect preserved; max side 1280; Vision detection max side 640; reject unhandled display transforms
sampling.eligibility: At least 4 context frames, 2 sampled core frames with detected hand evidence, and at least one valid crop position inside retained core after runtime trimming. Insufficient views are excluded, never relabeled background.
sampling.weighting: One source occurrence is one example group; average augmented-view losses per event so 72 views never count as 72 independent examples.

data_contract.roles: Preserve existing source train/validation roles; all windows, duplicate encodings, parent/session and within-source signer groups stay together.
data_contract.identity_limit: Within-source signer separation verified. Cross-corpus signer identity is not established; no global signer-disjoint claim.
data_contract.labels: One frozen Citizen raw-gloss/ASL-LEX variant per class. No synonym or numeric-variant merging.
data_contract.boundaries: ASLLRP/O5S5/STEM retain reviewed source intervals. MY cores were assistant-reviewed against approved sequences, not expert-certified. Uncertain approach/release and context are unlabeled.
data_contract.phone: Known failure recordings are development-only; mixed MY/LIKE region and aborted HAVE stay unlabeled; development recordings are not training or independent evaluation.
data_contract.transition_limit: No admitted ASLLRP HAVE→BIG occurrence found. Seven reviewed phone HAVE→BIG occurrences are development evidence, not training examples.

experiment.training: Frozen encoders; only fusion/word head adaptation; retain established 100-class isolated train replay with pinned provenance. No fragment/reject synthesis or unreviewed blank supervision.
experiment.model_selection: Declare optimizer, mixing weights, seeds, epoch bound and full cache hashes in executable recipe before first training. Include epoch 0; tune may select but is never described as independent.
experiment.runtime: Evaluate any contact preservation or continuous word-state change separately; do not rewrite labels from sentence expectations.

evaluation.retention: All 100 classes on existing validation splits; compare incumbent and candidate with identical inputs; require no aggregate loss and no per-class correct-count regression in this bounded experiment.
evaluation.target_controls: Report MY↔LIKE and HAVE↔ANGRY/TIRED confusions, omissions, duplicates, and full sentence edit errors. Genuine LIKE/ANGRY/TIRED must remain recognized; output counts alone are not recall.
evaluation.phase: All 8 auxiliary phases × 3 capture offsets on whole reviewed development sessions; report worst case and each case, not just averages. Source event/session remains the statistical unit.
evaluation.export: Matched letter head; Python/Core ML comparison on identical tensors; test all word/NAME/letter modes and retained word order.
evaluation.phone: New untouched normal shared-app sessions with intended MY NAME, MY FRIEND, I HAVE BIG and genuine LIKE/TIRED/ANGRY controls, multiple repetitions and signers. Freeze candidate and review labels before predictions; if used to tune, retire it from independent evaluation.
evaluation.protected_test: Do not rerun Citizen official test or lab protected test. Existing metadata used only for exclusion.

readiness_blockers: Complete and verify native inputs for all admitted train/validation events, including retained-core hand/crop coverage; pilot does not satisfy full materialization.
Verify core hand/crop coverage on every MY event; all 28 pass timestamp checks and the six native MY training pilot events pass evidence checks.
Freeze executable optimizer/mixing/selection recipe and full 100-class retention input hashes.
Reserve and capture independent phone evaluation; existing capture pack remains pending.

native_pilot.limitation: Includes development-only rows in shared arrays. Any future loader must select by pinned event membership and role, never load all array rows as training.
